question: In a certain code language, “DISEASE” is written as “EKVEASE”, and “FACULTY” is written as “GCFULTY”. How will “HELPFUL” be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e8d7f18fcf2b6801af6bc9d1c6a9b0f0dbfacea23a7bd8da0f6df6b5ef99f5.png] 

The logic followed here is:-

**The first three letters are increased by +1, +2, and +3 respectively, rest letters remain unchanged.**

 
• DISEASE
